exploration.pin_chunk_tooltip: Pin this chunk to track it in the diagnostic view
exploration.single_chunk_tooltip: This document produced a single chunk: splitting may have failed
exploration.non_url_source_tooltip: The source is not a URL and will not be usable as a link in answers
exploration.no_document_filtered_message: No document matches the active filters.

diagnostic.title: Retrieval diagnostic

capability_notes.hybrid_and_fts_not_implemented: This provider only supports vector search. Full text and hybrid modes are not implemented.
capability_notes.inspection_not_implemented: Vector store inspection is not implemented for this provider.
capability_notes.document_exploration_not_implemented: OpenSearch document exploration is not available yet.
capability_notes.pinned_exact_rank_not_implemented: Exact ranks for pinned chunks outside the retrieved results are unavailable with OpenSearch.

diagnostic.no_rag_configuration: No RAG configuration is defined for this bot: the form starts from defaults, which reflect nothing the bot does.
diagnostic.rag_disabled: RAG is disabled for this bot: these are its saved settings, but the runtime does not apply them.
diagnostic.settings_failed: The bot settings could not be loaded: the form starts from defaults, which may differ from what the bot does.
diagnostic.k_hint: Number of chunks each channel retrieves, then kept by the RRF fusion in hybrid mode. This is the pool handed to the compressor, or to the answering model when compression is off.
diagnostic.parallel_channels_tooltip: Both channels run in parallel from the same question and converge on the fusion
diagnostic.max_documents_exceeds_k: Max documents ({{maxDocuments}}) cannot exceed Max documents retrieved ({{k}}): the compressor runs on the {{k}} retrieved chunks and can only filter or reorder them, never widen the result. Lower Max documents to run the search.
diagnostic.compressor_only_reorders: With Max documents equal to the number of retrieved documents ({{k}}), no minimum score and no padding, the compressor keeps every chunk and only reorders them.
diagnostic.question_placeholder: The question as a user would ask it
diagnostic.keywords_required: Full text and hybrid modes require keywords.
diagnostic.index_not_found: The recorded index {{indexName}} is no longer available.
diagnostic.condensation_hint: Condensation is not deterministic: the search sends these values as they are, so a run can be replayed identically.
diagnostic.keywords_manual_hint: Without condensation no keyword is produced: they have to be typed in.
diagnostic.no_compressor_configured: No compressor configured for this bot
diagnostic.score_scale_hint: The score scale depends on the reranker model: pick the minimum score against the scores shown below, not an absolute value.
diagnostic.min_score_tooltip: Below this score the compressor drops the chunk
diagnostic.max_documents_tooltip: Maximum number of chunks the compressor keeps
diagnostic.fill_to_max_tooltip: Pulls back below-threshold chunks to reach the maximum document count
diagnostic.search_type_locked_tooltip: The search mode is taken from the bot configuration and cannot be changed here.
diagnostic.compression_fell_back: The compressor fell back or failed and returned no scores, so the thresholds cannot be retuned without a new search.
diagnostic.divergence_title: This configuration does not mirror the production chain
diagnostic.divergence_k: Max documents retrieved differs from the bot configuration.
diagnostic.divergence_compression: Compression state differs from what is configured for this bot.
diagnostic.divergence_max_documents: Compressor Max documents differs from the bot configuration.
diagnostic.divergence_min_score: Compressor Minimum score differs from the bot configuration.
diagnostic.no_pinned_hint: Pin chunks from the exploration view to track them even when absent from the results

fallback_reason.query_too_long: query too long for the reranker
fallback_reason.error: compression failed: in production, the request would fail

diagnostic.compressor_timeout_hint: The reranker uses the runtime timeout (compressor_provider_timeout): a larger Max documents retrieved can make it time out and fall back.
diagnostic.kept_summary: {{kept}} chunk(s) handed to the model out of {{total}} examined
diagnostic.not_in_channel_tooltip: This channel did not return this chunk
diagnostic.not_compressed_tooltip: This chunk never reached the compression stage

outcomes.kept_tooltip: Present in the context handed to the answering model
outcomes.cut_by_top_k_tooltip: Returned by the search, but dropped by the top-k cut
outcomes.below_min_score_tooltip: Reached the compressor but scored below the minimum
outcomes.reranked_out_tooltip: Above the threshold, but ranked past the maximum number of documents
outcomes.filled_below_threshold_tooltip: Scored below the threshold but pulled back to fill the document count
outcomes.cut_by_fallback_tooltip: The compressor fell back: only the first documents, in retrieval order and unscored, were passed on
outcomes.compression_failed_tooltip: Compression failed outside its fault tolerance: in production the request would fail and no chunk would be passed on
outcomes.not_retrieved_tooltip: Returned by no search channel at all

diagnostic.no_search_yet_message: Type a question and run a search to see the retrieval breakdown.

comparison.title: Compared to the reference run

passed_on.now_passed_on_tooltip: This chunk reaches the answering model in the current run, not in the reference
passed_on.no_longer_passed_on_tooltip: This chunk reached the answering model in the reference, it no longer does in the current run

absence.absent_from_index_tooltip: The two runs target different indexes and this chunk does not exist in the current one: an ingestion problem
absence.outside_k_tooltip: The chunk still exists but no longer surfaces within the retrieved window, a ranking problem
absence.unknown_tooltip: The index changed and this chunk was not explicitly checked, so its absence cannot be attributed to ingestion

comparison.pin_reference_tooltip: Freezes this run as the baseline for the next ones
